items.difficulty_reason: The selected formal factorization still requires constructing the nonroutine two-variable refinement and printed telescoping nine-term certificate for an exceptional four-variable quadratic sum. After these new equations are established, the coefficientwise uniqueness and one-variable Rogers–Ramanujan closing are routine, so this is conservatively H1 above ordinary qualification level. The certificate/refinement remains required core rather than a prerequisite, and no numerical specialization or neighboring Nandi result is counted.
